capabilities: Insert a day's events into a note at the cursor or via a Templater template
Fetch schedules from private iCal (.ics) feed URLs
Read Google calendars by ID using gcloud credentials
Render the schedule as a bullet list or table with RSVP and location details
Escape event titles and locations before inserting them
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also reads iCal feeds from Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail and other providers, not only Google Calendar.
extras: README warns that a private feed URL works like a password and explains how to reset leaked links; notes Google may stop gcloud's default sign-in from accessing the Calendar API; desktop only and tested mainly on macOS; the schedule is a one-off snapshot, not a sync.
problem: Obsidian daily notes have no built-in way to show that day's calendar events when a new note is created.

relations.evidence: reads Google calendars by ID using gcloud credentials
drop one line into your Templater daily-note template

requires.name: Google Calendar, Outlook/Microsoft 365, iCloud or other calendar provider via feed URL, or Google Cloud CLI plus Calendar API for Google calendars

summary: Inserts a day's calendar schedule from iCal feed URLs or the Google Calendar API into a note, designed for Templater daily-note templates.
